record.question: Which incompatibilities are detected in the anti globulin phase of a crossmatch?
record.explanation: Answer C: IgG alloantibodies in recipient's serum. In the antiglobulin phase, unbound serum is washed away and antihuman globulin detects IgG bound to donor RBCs; the phase targets clinically significant antibodies, often IgG. ABO incompatibility is ordinarily detected at immediate spin. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK585033/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
